## TierRules

Each member belongs to one tier: standard, student or senior. The tier sets the
loan length and the number of items that may be out at once.

## TierUpgrade

TierUpgrade moves a member to a new tier at the next renewal of their card,
never mid-term, so loan limits do not change underneath open loans.

## Guest cards

A guest card has the standard limits and expires after thirty days.
